stories.title: Hiromi Itoh Visits Chicago — Clock Expires Dec 1

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Hiromi Itoh visited Chicago this week for a free-agency meeting — and his clock expires December 1.

The right-hander posted a 3.18 ERA, 159 Ks over 172 innings in 2026. If the lockout hits on Dec 1, he goes back to Japan without a deal. Cubs need to decide fast. ⏰

Teruaki Sato just won the NPB Triple Crown — .306 BA, 39 home runs, 106 RBI. The Cubs have been watching closely.

His window is Dec 16, but the lockout makes Dec 1 the real deadline. Phillies, Yankees in. Hoyer has 8 days. 🎯
